row.title: Worker compatibility dates advance by a loop (COMPAT-DATE-1)
row.body: foundation/compatdate.py moves every compatibility date in doctrine/topology.json and tracked wrangler.toml files to today minus 30 days when it is 28 or more days behind, on every watchdog pass inside the runway step; openloops --check fails when a date passes 120 days. With Dependabot on every ecosystem, this closes the core input dependency-drift. second-tenant is declared a seed-lifecycle fixture: its idea names no product or user.
